Routine HVAC system clean
To properly prepare before performing HVAC maintenance at an indoor, unencapsilated basement (without direct exposure, dust cover) or any location in between:
Remove and set outside of house one window vent if attached (ensure secure, not damaged or exposed during clean).

Step #:
Unsecure, and carefully lift open return vents or duct cover access, using caution around exposed metal (wearing work attire). Gaze thoroughly for signs such dust buildup, dirt stains and/or other residue (which should trigger further evaluation or calling for help if excessive - not to clean at self)

Steps #
Vac the vent with attachments on the vac cleaner for all areas thoroughly
Remove, hose and dry each filter 
Wig the vents or open any cover fully

Finish steps #
Close vents securely and check to be the filter sits in right (no upside)

Check and re-ins
